Name: Prismatic Fire - All Minerals
Author: R43BIES
Description:
[b][color=#FF1493][size=4]Have you ever wanted to decorate your cozy farm with cute, color-changing lights?[/size][/color]
[/b] ﻿﻿ [color=#FF69B4][size=3][i]...Well- with this content pack- now you can![/i][/size][/color]

[size=2] ﻿Utilizing the[b] mod "[i]Prismatic Fire Continued[/i],"[/b] this pack adds a fire color-shift individual to each of the vanilla minerals and geodes. These unique colors can be applied by right-clicking a mineral or geode onto a fire source- all types of ﻿torches, fireplaces, and campfires included.

﻿Currently, all minerals and geodes have a fire color matched to their in-game, vanilla sprite. If others are interested in a pastel, dark, or neon series, let me know! I'd be happy to add more iterations over time :)[/size]

[color=#FF1493][size=2] ﻿HUGE thank you to [b]aedenthorn[/b] for their amazing mod(s)![/size][/color] [color=#ff69B4][size=2]And another thank you for making the process of creating this pack super easy. HUGE thank you to [b]recon88[/b] for updating the original mod for stability with 1.6![/size][/color]
